title: The Imperial Palace, Tokyo
summary: Tokyo's neutral ground of balanced Chi, where the Kuei-jin ancestor keeps court.

claims.text: Dragon lines converge on the Imperial Palace grounds in such balance that Tokyo's shen treat the compound as a shared preserve; they visit, but none tries to claim it for fear of spoiling the harmony and the Chi.
Hakari, the Kuei-jin ancestor of Tokyo, rules from the private Imperial quarters of the nishinomaru, and the city's hengeyokai come quietly to its gardens to commune with the natural forces there.
Tokyo's supernatural powers stay mostly within Central Tokyo, where the old palace sits a short walk from the Ginza and Kanda commercial districts, and not all their dealings there are friendly.

title: Tokyo Stock Exchange
summary: A trading floor where Syndicate mages draw on the global economy.

claims.text: Syndicate mages haunt the Tokyo Stock Exchange north of Nihonbashi Bridge, working Entropy on its trades and drawing Quintessence from the swings of the world market.
